title: First Blood

briefing.text:
5-minute loop — do this in order:
1) LMB-select the harvester (yellow spice bar). It auto-gathers at the bloom and unloads at your Refinery → Credits rise.
2) Press ? for hotkeys. Build with 1–6 (Windtrap if power dips). Select Factory → Q–Y to queue a tank.
3) Select combat units, RMB the red Ashveil camp on the eastern rock — destroy it.
Guard your Construction Yard. Enemy AI is off this mission. Optional: harvest 50 credits.

win_text: Victory — First blood. The ridge is quiet.
